notes.title: [Game Performance Optimization]
notes.content: After this update, you can enjoy the game even without downloading the patch from the official website.

notes.title: [Important] Battle Framework Optimization-Performance optimization
notes.content: In this update, we have replaced the original SV battle graphics with Dragonbone skeletal animation, which has significantly reduced the engine load during combat. We have also optimized the animations of certain pixel graphics. Additionally, we have adjusted the visual effects of some skills to enhance their performance.

notes.title: "Siltation Prayer" original price reduced!!!
notes.content: Due to market considerations, we have decided to lower the price of the game itself, and the current price is 60% of the original.
